_comment: STAGE3-0006 scoring.py survivor classification (LEAD proposals; approved_by stays null). Each rule maps a (definition, operator) family to an EXACT proof class. Matches the cr_scoring7 run against committed f9aa8aa (33 survivors).

rules.registered_domain_reachability: reachable only if a PMF mass sum lands with |sum-1| EXACTLY == 1e-9 as a double
rules.exact_reachable_state_evidence: PMF sums are accumulations of ~<=40 float terms; deviation is O(1e-16), never the exact 1e-9 boundary; > and >= agree off the measure-zero boundary
rules.malformed_input_reachability: NaN/inf refused by the isfinite guard regardless of >/>=
rules.pmf_comparison: identical (guard never triggers at the boundary)
rules.production_reference_comparison: unchanged (reference does not import this guard)

rules.exact_reachable_state_evidence: the point-1 special case is redundant (the general formula already yields True for n=1); (n-2) vs (n+2)/(n^2) and ==1 vs >=1 preserve ((.)//2)%2 over all reachable indices

n0 mutants (|1/^1/target+1/target^1 and n0+1 shifts) shift n0 by a multiple of the period-4 serve pattern for both valid targets, leaving (server(n0),server(n0+1)) unchanged; verified by the tail-servers pin over both targets

rules.registered_domain_reachability: reachable only if ff+oo == 1e-12 EXACTLY as a double
rules.exact_reachable_state_evidence: ff+oo is a product-sum of floats; equalling 1e-12 exactly is measure-zero; < and <= agree off that boundary

rules.registered_domain_reachability: operands are small ints in the CPython cached range [-5,256]
rules.exact_reachable_state_evidence: s,r,a,b,target-1 are all small ints; CPython caches [-5,256] so `is` == `==` for them; ENV-BOUND: CPython >=3.11
rules.proof_artifact_digest: cpython-small-int-cache; MANDATORY-RECLASSIFY on a non-CPython interpreter

rules.exact_reachable_state_evidence: when s==r and the other bound is >=3, s>=3 automatically; so s>=3->s>=2 (and r) is subsumed by (s==r and other>=3)
(a+b)%2 == (a-b)%2 == (a^b)%2 for all integers (subtraction/XOR preserve bit 0); and %2 in {0,1} so ==0 <=> <=0

n=a+b+1 mutants (a+b-1, a+b<<1) globally shift the per-point server assignment; the tiebreak WIN probability is invariant under a full serve-schedule reversal (verified diff 1.11e-16); the per-point PATH differs but is not an output of tiebreak_win_prob. Killable by a pinned _next_point seam (offered).
rules.output_fields_affected: none in the returned win probability

rules.registered_domain_reachability: at most one 6-6 state per DP level
rules.exact_reachable_state_evidence: terminals.get((7,6),0.0) reads a key that is always ABSENT at the single first write per level (one 6-6 per level), so the default 0.0 is used regardless of the mutated key. Killable by direct assignment (offered).
first_wins = sum(pr for (a,b) if a>b); no terminal set score has a==b (6-6 is converted to 7-6/6-7), so a>b vs a>=b agree over the games keys
